topic: Upcoming firmware and core service improvements
summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding data quality adjustments, noting that a routine data validation process is run every 6–12 months to ensure consistency with environment changes. [p2] prepared an email containing release notes for Germany and Lithuania detailing upcoming improvements in AllUnite firmware and core services; this communication was confirmed as informational only and would not impact current data.

Later, it was determined that the launch of a planned release is pending confirmation from AFA and Datacorp. Furthermore, [p1] offered to provide requested sensor data for Gabrielle.
decisions: The email regarding firmware/core service improvements for Germany and Lithuania can be sent.
The release launch must wait for confirmation from AFA and Datacorp.
action_items: [p2] to send the sensor data provided by [p1] to Gabrielle.
